title.zh: 规定在北甘马粦省Jose Panganiban市镇设立工艺与贸易学校，名称为北甘马粦工艺与贸易学校，并授权为此拨款
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Jose Panganiban in the Province of Camarines Norte, to be Known as the Camarines Norte School of Arts and Trades and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Jose Panganiban in the Province of Camarines Norte, to be Known as the Camarines Norte School of Arts and Trades and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5259_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Camarines Norte School of Arts and Trades is hereby established in the Municipality of Jose Panganiban in the Province of Camarines Norte under the direct supervision of the Director of Vocational Education.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school of arts and trades during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-nine. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
